calibration_drift_dev_conf.note: features, training, calibration and served inference share the Go float32 trunk path; with a float32 cache the served logits equal the trained ones bit for bit on the feature kernel

act_head.objective: class-balanced cross-entropy: act when the scorer's argmax is the label

training.loss: choice and score: softmax cross-entropy against the label or its label_dist (listwise softmax ranking loss over graded items); score adds 0.50 x normalised expected-level squared error; yes_no: logistic loss on the margin; act head: class-balanced cross-entropy

evaluation.states: float32 trunk states of the Go encoder (internal/layago/model), the numbers laya.LoadArtifact serves, every split including train

limitations: synthetic_engineering evidence: trained and evaluated on generated data only
outputs are nominations with no numeric or evidence authority
temperatures and thresholds are synthetic calibration until verified labels exist
dev is too small for part of the calibration (10 shortfalls in training.dev_halves): the tasks named there fall back to a wider temperature or cannot certify an act threshold and always escalate
